  53:     if (def.limits && Number.isInteger(def.limits.maxPerOwner) && activeOwned >= def.limits.maxPerOwner) return fail('owner_attachment_limit');
  54: 
  55:     const id = `att_${String(state.combat.attachments.nextId++).padStart(6, '0')}`;
  56:     const sourceWorld = socketWorldPosition(owner, sourceSocket);
  57:     const targetWorld = socketWorldPosition(target, targetSocket);
  58:     const restLength = Math.hypot(targetWorld.x - sourceWorld.x, targetWorld.z - sourceWorld.z);
  59:     const attachment = {
  60:       id,
  61:       defId: def.id,
  62:       ownerId: owner.id,
  63:       targetId: target.id,
  64:       sourceSocketId: sourceSocket.id,
  65:       targetSocketId: targetSocket.id,
  66:       physicsHandle: null,
  67:       state: 'active',
  68:       createdTick: state.tick,
  69:       brokenTick: null,
  70:       breakReason: null,
  71:       restLength,
  72:       lastTension: 0,
  73:       lastImpulse: 0,
  74:       nearBreakWarned: false,
  75:       actionInstanceId: spec.actionInstanceId || null,
  76:     };
  77:     const physicsResult = createPhysicsAttachment(attachment, def);
  78:     if (!physicsResult.ok) return fail(physicsResult.reason, physicsResult.error);
  79:     attachment.physicsHandle = serializableHandle(physicsResult.physicsHandle);
  80:     state.combat.attachments.byId[id] = attachment;
  81:     appendCombatTrace(state.combat, state.tick, 'attachment.created', {
  82:       actorId: owner.id,
  83:       targetId: target.id,
  84:       attachmentId: id,
  85:       attachmentDefId: def.id,
  86:       sourceSocketId: sourceSocket.id,
  87:       targetSocketId: targetSocket.id,
  88:       restLength,
  89:       cueId: def.cues && def.cues.created,
  90:     });
  91:     if (bus) bus.emit('tether:attached', {
  92:       actorId: owner.id,
  93:       targetId: target.id,
  94:       attachmentId: id,
  95:       attachmentDefId: def.id,
  96:       sourceSocketId: sourceSocket.id,
  97:       targetSocketId: targetSocket.id,
  98:       restLength,
  99:       cueId: def.cues && def.cues.created,
 100:     });
 101:     return { ok: true, attachment };
 102:   }
 103: 
 104:   function reel(attachmentId, restLengthDelta, minRestLength = 0) {
 105:     const attachment = get(attachmentId);
 106:     const physics = combatPhysics();
 107:     if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return fail('attachment_missing');
 108:     if (!physics || typeof physics.setAttachmentReel !== 'function') return fail('physics_port_unavailable');
 109:     const next = Math.max(Math.max(0, Number(minRestLength) || 0), attachment.restLength + (Number(restLengthDelta) || 0));
 110:     try {
 111:       const accepted = physics.setAttachmentReel({
 112:         attachmentId: attachment.id,
 113:         physicsHandle: attachment.physicsHandle,
 114:         restLength: next,
 115:         previousRestLength: attachment.restLength,
 116:         tick: state.tick,
 117:       });
 118:       if (accepted === false) return fail('physics_reel_rejected');
 119:     } catch (error) {
 120:       return fail('physics_reel_failed', error);
 121:     }
 122:     const before = attachment.restLength;
 123:     attachment.restLength = next;
 124:     if (attachment.masslineRuntime) {
 125:       attachment.masslineRuntime.restLength = next;
 126:       attachment.masslineRuntime.targetLength = next;
 127:       attachment.masslineRuntime.reelVelocity = 0;
 128:     }
 129:     appendCombatTrace(state.combat, state.tick, 'attachment.reel', {
 130:       actorId: attachment.ownerId,
 131:       targetId: attachment.targetId,
 132:       attachmentId: attachment.id,
 133:       before,
 134:       after: next,
 135:     });
 136:     if (bus) bus.emit('tether:reel', {
 137:       actorId: attachment.ownerId,
 138:       targetId: attachment.targetId,
 139:       attachmentId: attachment.id,
 140:       before,
 141:       after: next,
 142:     });
 143:     return { ok: true, attachment };
 144:   }
 145: 
 146:   function cut(attachmentId, actorId, reason = 'cut') {
 147:     const attachment = get(attachmentId);
 148:     if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return fail('attachment_missing');
 149:     if (actorId != null && attachment.ownerId !== actorId) return fail('not_attachment_owner');
 150:     return breakAttachment(attachment, reason, actorId);
 151:   }
 152: 
 153:   function breakAttachment(attachmentOrId, reason = 'break', actorId = null, telemetry = null) {
 154:     const attachment = typeof attachmentOrId === 'string' ? get(attachmentOrId) : attachmentOrId;
 155:     const physics = combatPhysics();
 156:     if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return fail('attachment_missing');
 157:     if (physics && typeof physics.cutAttachment === 'function') {
 158:       try {
 159:         physics.cutAttachment({
 160:           attachmentId: attachment.id,
 161:           physicsHandle: attachment.physicsHandle,
 162:           reason,
 163:           tick: state.tick,
 164:         });
 165:       } catch (error) {
 166:         return fail('physics_cut_failed', error);
 167:       }
 168:     } else if (reason !== 'physics_break') {
 169:       return fail('physics_port_unavailable');
 170:     }
 171:     attachment.state = 'broken';
 172:     attachment.brokenTick = state.tick;
 173:     attachment.breakReason = reason;
 174:     if (telemetry) {
 175:       attachment.lastTension = finiteOrZero(telemetry.tension);
 176:       attachment.lastImpulse = finiteOrZero(telemetry.impulse);
 177:     }
 178:     const def = catalog.attachments.get(attachment.defId);
 179:     appendCombatTrace(state.combat, state.tick, 'attachment.broken', {
 180:       actorId: actorId == null ? attachment.ownerId : actorId,
 181:       targetId: attachment.targetId,
 182:       attachmentId: attachment.id,
 183:       reason,
 184:       tension: attachment.lastTension,
 185:       impulse: attachment.lastImpulse,
 186:       cueId: def && def.cues && def.cues.broken,
 187:     });
 188:     if (bus) bus.emit('tether:broken', {
 189:       actorId: actorId == null ? attachment.ownerId : actorId,
 190:       targetId: attachment.targetId,
 191:       attachmentId: attachment.id,
 192:       reason,
 193:       tension: attachment.lastTension,
 194:       impulse: attachment.lastImpulse,
 195:       cueId: def && def.cues && def.cues.broken,
 196:     });
 197:     return { ok: true, attachment };
 198:   }
 199: 
 200:   function breakOwnedBy(ownerId, reason = 'owner_disabled') {
 201:     const broken = [];
 202:     for (const attachment of Object.values(state.combat.attachments.byId).sort(byId)) {
 203:       if (attachment.state !== 'active' || attachment.ownerId !== ownerId) continue;
 204:       const result = breakAttachment(attachment, reason, ownerId);
 205:       if (result.ok) broken.push(attachment.id);
 206:     }
 207:     return broken;
 208:   }
 209: 
 210:   function reconcilePhysics() {
 211:     const physics = combatPhysics();
 212:     if (!physics || typeof physics.createAttachment !== 'function' || typeof physics.getAttachmentTelemetry !== 'function') {
 213:       return { recreated: 0, pending: 0 };
 214:     }
 215:     let recreated = 0;
 216:     let pending = 0;
 217:     for (const attachment of Object.values(state.combat.attachments.byId).sort(byId)) {
 218:       if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') continue;
 219:       let telemetry = null;
 220:       try {
 221:         telemetry = physics.getAttachmentTelemetry({
 222:           attachmentId: attachment.id,
 223:           physicsHandle: attachment.physicsHandle,
 224:           tick: state.tick,
 225:         });
 226:       } catch (_) {
 227:         telemetry = null;
 228:       }
 229:       if (telemetry) continue;
 230:       const def = catalog.attachments.get(attachment.defId);
 231:       if (!def) { pending++; continue; }
 232:       const result = createPhysicsAttachment(attachment, def);
 233:       if (!result.ok) { pending++; continue; }
 234:       attachment.physicsHandle = serializableHandle(result.physicsHandle);
 235:       recreated++;
 236:       appendCombatTrace(state.combat, state.tick, 'attachment.physicsReconciled', {
 237:         actorId: attachment.ownerId,
 238:         targetId: attachment.targetId,
 239:         attachmentId: attachment.id,
 240:         attachmentDefId: attachment.defId,
 241:       });
 242:     }
 243:     return { recreated, pending };
 244:   }
 245: 
 246:   function transfer(attachmentId, fromOwnerId, toOwnerId) {
 247:     const attachment = get(attachmentId);
 248:     const def = attachment && catalog.attachments.get(attachment.defId);
 249:     if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return fail('attachment_missing');
 250:     if (attachment.ownerId !== fromOwnerId) return fail('not_attachment_owner');
 251:     if (!def || !def.ownership || !def.ownership.transferable) return fail('ownership_not_transferable');
 252:     if (!entity(toOwnerId)) return fail('new_owner_missing');
 253:     attachment.ownerId = toOwnerId;
 254:     appendCombatTrace(state.combat, state.tick, 'attachment.ownerTransferred', {
 255:       actorId: fromOwnerId,
 256:       targetId: toOwnerId,
 257:       attachmentId,
 258:     });
 259:     return { ok: true, attachment };
 260:   }
 261: 
 262:   function updateTelemetryAndBreak() {
 263:     const physics = combatPhysics();
 264:     if (!physics || typeof physics.getAttachmentTelemetry !== 'function') return;
 265:     for (const attachment of Object.values(state.combat.attachments.byId).sort(byId)) {
 266:       if (attachment.state !== 'active') continue;
 267:       const def = catalog.attachments.get(attachment.defId);
 268:       if (!def) continue;
 269:       let telemetry;
 270:       try {
 271:         telemetry = physics.getAttachmentTelemetry({ attachmentId: attachment.id, physicsHandle: attachment.physicsHandle, tick: state.tick });
 272:       } catch (_) {
 273:         continue;
 274:       }
 275:       if (!telemetry) continue;
 276:       attachment.lastTension = finiteOrZero(telemetry.tension);
 277:       attachment.lastImpulse = finiteOrZero(telemetry.impulse);
 278:       const grace = Math.max(0, Number(def.break && def.break.graceTicks) || 0);
 279: 
 280:       // Massline controller: run the winch/heat/overload policy (spec §8) one step per fixed tick
 281:       // and apply its rest-length command to the Rapier joint. Rapier still owns momentum exchange
 282:       // (mass-ratio-driven swing/reel); the controller only owns the winch + break policy. This is
 283:       // what turns the scripted tether into a physical mass-ratio-driven Massline.
 284:       // Massline controller (spec §8): run the winch/heat/overload policy one step per fixed tick
 285:       // and apply its rest-length command to the Rapier joint. Opt-in per attachment def via a
 286:       // `massline: { enabled: true }` block, so existing scenario tethers keep their proven
 287:       // dynamics until a def deliberately adopts the controller. When enabled, Rapier still owns
 288:       // momentum exchange (mass-ratio-driven swing/reel); the controller only owns the winch +
 289:       // break policy. Joint rebuilds are conservative (only on a meaningful length change) to
 290:       // avoid destabilizing the solver with per-tick joint recreation.
 291:       const masslinePolicy = def.massline && def.massline.enabled;
 292:       if (masslinePolicy && state.tick - attachment.createdTick >= grace) {
 293:         const masslineDef = masslineDefFor(def);
 294:         if (!attachment.masslineRuntime) {
 295:           // Seed the winch from the ACTUAL attachment rest length, not the def's defaultLength,
 296:           // so a neutral (no-reel) command holds the engagement distance rather than drifting the
 297:           // ships toward an arbitrary 70-unit separation. The controller only moves the joint when
 298:           // a reel command is issued or physics stretches the line.
 299:           const runtime = createMasslineRuntime(masslineDef);
 300:           const seed = attachment.restLength > 0 ? attachment.restLength : runtime.restLength;
 301:           runtime.restLength = seed;
 302:           runtime.targetLength = seed;
 303:           attachment.masslineRuntime = runtime;
 304:         }
 305:         const owner = entity(attachment.ownerId);
 306:         const target = entity(attachment.targetId);
 307:         const ml = stepMassline({
 308:           dt: SIM_DT,
 309:           def: masslineDef,
 310:           runtime: attachment.masslineRuntime,
 311:           telemetry: {
 312:             attachmentId: attachment.id,
 313:             restLength: telemetry.restLength,
 314:             distance: telemetry.distance,
 315:             stretch: telemetry.stretch,
 316:             relativeSpeed: telemetry.relativeSpeed,
 317:             tension: telemetry.tension,
 318:             impulse: telemetry.impulse,
 319:           },
 320:           command: { reel: 0, hold: true, cut: false },
 321:           ownerBody: owner && { mass: finiteOrZero(owner.physicsBody && owner.physicsBody.mass) || finiteOrZero(owner.mass) || 1 },
 322:           targetBody: target && { mass: finiteOrZero(target.physicsBody && target.physicsBody.mass) || finiteOrZero(target.mass) || 1 },
 323:         });
 324:         attachment.masslineRuntime = ml.runtime;
 325:         attachment.masslineTelemetry = ml.telemetry;
 326:         // Apply the controller's rest length only on a meaningful change (>= 2 units). Rebuilding
 327:         // a Rapier rope joint every tick resets solver contact state and destabilizes the tether;
 328:         // the winch is a slow actuator, so a coarse threshold is physically appropriate.
 329:         if (ml.action.restLength > 0 && Math.abs(ml.action.restLength - attachment.restLength) >= 2.0) {
 330:           try {
 331:             if (physics.setAttachmentReel) {
 332:               physics.setAttachmentReel({
 333:                 attachmentId: attachment.id,
 334:                 physicsHandle: attachment.physicsHandle,
 335:                 restLength: ml.action.restLength,
 336:                 previousRestLength: attachment.restLength,
 337:                 tick: state.tick,
 338:               });
 339:               attachment.restLength = ml.action.restLength;
 340:             }

diff --git a/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..095821825c23af2afa14dc5721b2b40de25a462f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+
+import { createBus } from '../src/core/eventBus.js';
+import { createGameState } from '../src/core/gameState.js';
+import { core } from '../src/core/coreSystem.js';
+import { physics } from '../src/core/physics.js';
+import { SIM_DT } from '../src/core/sim.js';
+import { actions } from '../src/systems/actions.js';
+import { combat } from '../src/systems/combat.js';
+import { flightV3 } from '../src/systems/flightV3.js';
+import { makeShipEntitySpec } from '../src/systems/ships.js';
+import { tetherGameplay } from '../src/systems/tetherGameplay.js';
+
+const DT = SIM_DT;
+const ARC_TICKS = Math.round(1.2 / DT);
+
+await assertGameplaySlingshot();
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether');
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether-break');
+
+console.log('Tether gameplay checks OK');
+
+async function assertGameplaySlingshot() {
+  const harness = createHarness();
+  const { state, helpers, runtime, events } = harness;
+
+  const player = helpers.spawnEntity(makeShipEntitySpec('ship_wasp', {
+    isPlayer: true,
+    pos: { x: -20, z: -92 },
+    rot: 0,
+  }));
+  state.playerId = player.id;
+  const asteroid = helpers.spawnEntity({
+    type: 'asteroid',
+    pos: { x: 0, z: 0 },
+    radius: 11,
+    mass: 640,
+    hull: 360,
+    hullMax: 360,
+    collides: true,
+    data: { typeId: 'ast_common_rock', oreHP: 360, oreHPMax: 360, yieldU: 12 },
+  });
+
+  player.vel.x = player.maxSpeed * 0.8;
+  player.vel.z = 0;
+  player.boost.energy = player.boost.max;
+  state.input.actions = { tetherFire: false, tetherCut: false, reelDelta: 0 };
+  state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+  state.input.aimAngle = 0;
+  state.input.moveX = 0;
+  state.input.moveZ = 1;
+  state.input.boost = true;
+
+  initializeSystems(harness);
+  await ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state);
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, player.id), player.mass, 'player Rapier mass should come from the ship def mass');
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, asteroid.id), asteroid.mass, 'asteroid Rapier mass should come from entity mass');
+
+  const preLatch = velocityVector(player);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = false;
+
+  assert.equal(events.latched.length, 1, 'tetherFire should emit tether:latched once');
+  assert.equal(events.latched[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'tether should latch the aimed asteroid');
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < ARC_TICKS; i++) {
+    state.input.actions.reelDelta = 0;
+    state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+    stepHarness(harness);
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(events.broke.length, 0, 'mid asteroid slingshot should not break the standard tether');
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = false;
+
+  const postCut = velocityVector(player);
+  const preSpeed = speed(preLatch);
+  const postSpeed = speed(postCut);
+  const headingDeltaDeg = angleBetweenDeg(preLatch, postCut);
+
+  assert(postSpeed >= preSpeed * 1.25,
+    `post-cut speed should be >=1.25x pre-latch speed; ${postSpeed.toFixed(2)} vs ${preSpeed.toFixed(2)}`);
+  assert(headingDeltaDeg >= 70,
+    `post-cut heading should change by >=70 degrees; got ${headingDeltaDeg.toFixed(1)}`);
+  assert.equal(events.released.length, 1, 'tetherCut should emit tether:released once');
+  assert.equal(events.released[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'released event should identify the asteroid');
+
+  const attachments = state.combat.attachments.byId;
+  const active = Object.values(attachments).filter((attachment) => attachment.state === 'active');
+  assert.equal(active.length, 0, 'tetherCut should leave no active attachment');
+}
+
+function createHarness() {
+  const state = createGameState(0x57d1);
+  state.mode = 'flight';
+  state.settings.gameplay.physicsBackend = 'rapier-dynamic';
+  state.settings.gameplay.flightBackend = 'v3';
+  state.settings.controls.flightMode = 'newtonian';
+  state.entities.clear();
+  state.entityList.length = 0;
+  state.nextEntityId = 1;
+  state.freeIds.length = 0;
+
+  const bus = createBus();
+  const helpers = {};
+  const runtime = {
+    core: fork(core),
+    physics: fork(physics),
+    actions: fork(actions),
+    flight: fork(flightV3),
+    combat: fork(combat),
+    tetherGameplay: fork(tetherGameplay),
+  };
+  const byName = new Map([
+    ['core', runtime.core],
+    ['physics', runtime.physics],
+    ['actions', runtime.actions],
+    ['flight', runtime.flight],
+    ['combat', runtime.combat],
+    ['tetherGameplay', runtime.tetherGameplay],
+  ]);
+  const registry = {
+    get(name) { return byName.get(name) || null; },
+  };
+  const ctx = { state, bus, helpers, registry };
+
+  const events = { latched: [], strain: [], broke: [], released: [] };
+  bus.on('tether:latched', (payload) => events.latched.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:strain', (payload) => events.strain.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:broke', (payload) => events.broke.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:released', (payload) => events.released.push(payload));
+
+  runtime.core.init(ctx);
+  return { state, bus, helpers, registry, runtime, ctx, events };
+}
+
+function initializeSystems(harness) {
+  const { runtime, ctx } = harness;
+  runtime.physics.init(ctx);
+  runtime.actions.init(ctx);
+  runtime.flight.init(ctx);
+  runtime.combat.init(ctx);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.init(ctx);
+}
+
+async function ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state) {
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  if (runtime.physics._sg02Init) await runtime.physics._sg02Init;
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  assert(runtime.physics._sg02, 'SG-02 dynamic body owner should initialize for tether gameplay check');
+}
+
+function stepHarness(harness) {
+  const { runtime, state } = harness;
+  runtime.core.preStep(DT, state);
+  runtime.actions.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.flight.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.physics.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.combat.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.core.lifetimeSweep(DT, state);
+}
+
+function readPhysicsMass(runtime, entityId) {
+  const rec = runtime.physics._sg02 && runtime.physics._sg02.records.get(entityId);
+  return rec && rec.spec && rec.spec.mass;
+}
+
+function assertNpmScript(name) {
+  const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', name], {
+    cwd: new URL('../', import.meta.url),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    shell: process.platform === 'win32',
+  });
+  if (result.status !== 0) {
+    process.stdout.write(result.stdout || '');
+    process.stderr.write(result.stderr || '');
+  }
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${name} should pass`);
+}
+
+function fork(definition) {
+  return Object.create(definition);
+}
+
+function velocityVector(entity) {
+  return { x: entity.vel.x, z: entity.vel.z };
+}
+
+function speed(vector) {
+  return Math.hypot(vector.x, vector.z);
+}
+
+function angleBetweenDeg(a, b) {
+  const al = speed(a);
+  const bl = speed(b);
+  if (!(al > 0) || !(bl > 0)) return 0;
+  const dot = (a.x * b.x + a.z * b.z) / (al * bl);
+  const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dot));
+  return Math.acos(clamped) * 180 / Math.PI;
+}
diff --git a/src/combat/attachments.js b/src/combat/attachments.js
index 979e1b507349b302aa50a4097e60527dbafe05ba..adb0d16c823eace5590c6f1c20b12d155af3936f

+++ b/src/combat/attachments.js

 // the winch/heat/reel policy comes from the generated DEFAULT_MASSLINE_DEF so the controller's
 // mass-ratio-driven behavior (heavy target stalls the winch, sustained overload breaks the line)
 // is the live contract, not an ad-hoc scripted tether.
-function masslineDefFor(def) {
-  const brk = (def && def.break) || {};
-  return {
-    maxTension: Number.isFinite(brk.maxTension) ? brk.maxTension : 140,
-    maxImpulse: Number.isFinite(brk.maxImpulse) ? brk.maxImpulse : 90,
-    overloadGraceS: 0.18,
-    catastrophicRatio: 1.75,
-  };
+function masslineDefFor(def) {
+  const brk = (def && def.break) || {};
+  const reelRate = Number.isFinite(def && def.reelRate) ? def.reelRate : null;
+  return {
+    minLength: Number.isFinite(def && def.minLength) ? def.minLength : undefined,
+    maxLength: Number.isFinite(def && def.maxLength) ? def.maxLength : undefined,
+    reelInSpeed: reelRate == null ? undefined : reelRate,
+    reelOutSpeed: reelRate == null ? undefined : reelRate,
+    maxTension: Number.isFinite(brk.maxTension) ? brk.maxTension : 140,
+    maxImpulse: Number.isFinite(brk.maxImpulse) ? brk.maxImpulse : 90,
+    overloadGraceS: 0.18,
+    catastrophicRatio: 1.75,
+  };
 }
 
 export function createAttachmentService(context) {

     } catch (error) {
       return fail('physics_reel_failed', error);

-    const before = attachment.restLength;

diff --git a/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4be3c6241f066121f8d20e4539e28a7b27caf8ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
@@ -0,0 +1,199 @@
+// Tether gameplay system (GDD 2.0 §4.3, BUILD_PLAN WS-D1).
+// Consumes the locked input action contract and wires the existing SG-03/SG-02 attachment
+// service into player flight. Rapier owns momentum exchange; this system only targets,
+// reels, cuts, and emits player-facing gameplay events.
+import { queryNearbyEntities } from '../core/spatialQuery.js';
+
+const TETHER_DEF_ID = 'tether_standard';
+const STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S = 0.2;
+const ATTACHABLE_TYPES = new Set(['asteroid', 'wreck', 'ship', 'drone', 'station', 'payload']);
+
+export const tetherGameplay = {
+  id: 'tetherGameplay',
+  name: 'tetherGameplay',
+
+  init(ctx) {
+    this.state = ctx.state;
+    this.bus = ctx.bus;
+    this.helpers = ctx.helpers;
+    this.registry = ctx.registry;
+    this._targetScratch = [];
+    this._active = null;
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  update(dt, state) {
+    if (state.mode !== 'flight') return;
+    const player = state.entities && state.entities.get ? state.entities.get(state.playerId) : null;
+    if (!player || !player.alive || (player.flags && player.flags.docked)) return;
+
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const attachments = kernel && kernel.attachments;
+    if (!attachments) return;
+
+    this._reconcileActive(attachments, state);
+    const actions = state.input?.actions;
+
+    if (this._active && actions?.tetherCut) {
+      const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+      const result = attachments.cut(this._active.attachmentId, player.id, 'tether_cut');
+      if (result && result.ok) this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+      this._active = null;
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (this._active) {
+      this._reelActive(attachments, actions?.reelDelta, dt);
+      this._emitStrain(attachments, state);
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!actions?.tetherFire) return;
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, TETHER_DEF_ID);
+    if (!def) return;
+    const target = this._acquireTarget(player, def, state);
+    if (!target) return;
+
+    const result = attachments.create({
+      defId: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+      ownerId: player.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+    });
+    if (!result || !result.ok || !result.attachment) return;
+
+    this._active = {
+      attachmentId: result.attachment.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+      type: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+    };
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:latched', { targetId: target.id, type: TETHER_DEF_ID });
+  },
+
+  _acquireTarget(player, def, state) {
+    const maxLength = positive(def && def.maxLength, positive(def && def.break && def.break.maxLength, 260));
+    const aim = aimWorldFor(player, state, maxLength);
+    const candidates = queryNearbyEntities(
+      state,
+      aim,
+      maxLength,
+      this._targetScratch,
+      state.entityList || [],
+    );
+
+    let best = null;
+    let bestAimD2 = Infinity;
+    let bestId = Infinity;
+    for (const entity of candidates) {
+      if (!isAttachable(entity, player.id)) continue;
+      const dxPlayer = entity.pos.x - player.pos.x;
+      const dzPlayer = entity.pos.z - player.pos.z;
+      const playerDistance = Math.hypot(dxPlayer, dzPlayer);
+      if (playerDistance > maxLength + (entity.radius || 0)) continue;
+
+      const dxAim = entity.pos.x - aim.x;
+      const dzAim = entity.pos.z - aim.z;
+      const aimD2 = dxAim * dxAim + dzAim * dzAim;
+      if (aimD2 > maxLength * maxLength) continue;
+      const id = sortableId(entity.id);
+      if (aimD2 < bestAimD2 || (aimD2 === bestAimD2 && id < bestId)) {
+        best = entity;
+        bestAimD2 = aimD2;
+        bestId = id;
+      }
+    }
+    return best;
+  },
+
+  _reconcileActive(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (attachment && attachment.state === 'active') return;
+    const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+    const reason = attachment && attachment.breakReason;
+    this._active = null;
+    if (reason === 'tether_cut') this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+    else this.bus.emit('tether:broke', { targetId });
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  _reelActive(attachments, reelDelta, dt) {
+    if (!this._active || !Number.isFinite(reelDelta) || reelDelta === 0) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    if (!def) return;
+
+    const maxStep = positive(def.reelRate, 0) * Math.max(0, Number(dt) || 0);
+    if (!(maxStep > 0)) return;
+    const requested = clamp(reelDelta, -maxStep, maxStep);
+    const minLength = positive(def.minLength, 0);
+    const maxLength = positive(def.maxLength, Infinity);
+    const next = clamp((attachment.restLength || 0) + requested, minLength, maxLength);
+    const delta = next - (attachment.restLength || 0);
+    if (Math.abs(delta) <= 1e-6) return;
+    attachments.reel(attachment.id, delta, minLength);
+  },
+
+  _emitStrain(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const now = Number.isFinite(state.simTime) ? state.simTime : state.tick / 60;
+    if (now - this._lastStrainT < STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    const threshold = positive(def && (def.breakTension || (def.break && def.break.maxTension)), 0);
+    if (!(threshold > 0)) return;
+    const ratio = Math.max(0, finite(attachment.lastTension) / threshold);
+    this._lastStrainT = now;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:strain', { ratio });
+  },
+};
+
+function combatKernel(host) {
+  const actions = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('actions');
+  if (actions && actions.kernel) return actions.kernel;
+  const combat = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('combat');
+  return combat && combat.kernel ? combat.kernel : null;
+}
+
+function attachmentDef(kernel, id) {
+  return kernel && kernel.catalog && kernel.catalog.attachments && kernel.catalog.attachments.get(id) || null;
+}
+
+function aimWorldFor(player, state, range) {
+  const aim = state.input?.aimWorld;
+  if (Number.isFinite(aim?.x) && Number.isFinite(aim?.z)) return { x: aim.x, z: aim.z };
+  const angle = Number.isFinite(state.input?.aimAngle) ? state.input.aimAngle : (player.rot || 0);
+  return {
+    x: player.pos.x + Math.cos(angle) * range,
+    z: player.pos.z + Math.sin(angle) * range,
+  };
+}
+
+function isAttachable(entity, playerId) {
+  if (!entity || !entity.alive || !entity.pos || entity.id === playerId) return false;
+  if (ATTACHABLE_TYPES.has(entity.type)) return true;
+  if (entity.type !== 'pickup') return false;
+  const data = entity.data || {};
+  if (data.kind !== 'cargo' && data.kind !== 'ore') return false;
+  return (Number(data.amount) || 0) > 5;
+}
+
+function sortableId(id) {
+  return Number.isFinite(id) ? id : String(id).charCodeAt(0);
+}
+
+function clamp(value, lo, hi) {
+  return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, value));
+}
+
+function positive(value, fallback) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
+}
+
+function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
+}

diff --git a/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..095821825c23af2afa14dc5721b2b40de25a462f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+
+import { createBus } from '../src/core/eventBus.js';
+import { createGameState } from '../src/core/gameState.js';
+import { core } from '../src/core/coreSystem.js';
+import { physics } from '../src/core/physics.js';
+import { SIM_DT } from '../src/core/sim.js';
+import { actions } from '../src/systems/actions.js';
+import { combat } from '../src/systems/combat.js';
+import { flightV3 } from '../src/systems/flightV3.js';
+import { makeShipEntitySpec } from '../src/systems/ships.js';
+import { tetherGameplay } from '../src/systems/tetherGameplay.js';
+
+const DT = SIM_DT;
+const ARC_TICKS = Math.round(1.2 / DT);
+
+await assertGameplaySlingshot();
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether');
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether-break');
+
+console.log('Tether gameplay checks OK');
+
+async function assertGameplaySlingshot() {
+  const harness = createHarness();
+  const { state, helpers, runtime, events } = harness;
+
+  const player = helpers.spawnEntity(makeShipEntitySpec('ship_wasp', {
+    isPlayer: true,
+    pos: { x: -20, z: -92 },
+    rot: 0,
+  }));
+  state.playerId = player.id;
+  const asteroid = helpers.spawnEntity({
+    type: 'asteroid',
+    pos: { x: 0, z: 0 },
+    radius: 11,
+    mass: 640,
+    hull: 360,
+    hullMax: 360,
+    collides: true,
+    data: { typeId: 'ast_common_rock', oreHP: 360, oreHPMax: 360, yieldU: 12 },
+  });
+
+  player.vel.x = player.maxSpeed * 0.8;
+  player.vel.z = 0;
+  player.boost.energy = player.boost.max;
+  state.input.actions = { tetherFire: false, tetherCut: false, reelDelta: 0 };
+  state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+  state.input.aimAngle = 0;
+  state.input.moveX = 0;
+  state.input.moveZ = 1;
+  state.input.boost = true;
+
+  initializeSystems(harness);
+  await ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state);
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, player.id), player.mass, 'player Rapier mass should come from the ship def mass');
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, asteroid.id), asteroid.mass, 'asteroid Rapier mass should come from entity mass');
+
+  const preLatch = velocityVector(player);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = false;
+
+  assert.equal(events.latched.length, 1, 'tetherFire should emit tether:latched once');
+  assert.equal(events.latched[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'tether should latch the aimed asteroid');
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < ARC_TICKS; i++) {
+    state.input.actions.reelDelta = 0;
+    state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+    stepHarness(harness);
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(events.broke.length, 0, 'mid asteroid slingshot should not break the standard tether');
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = false;
+
+  const postCut = velocityVector(player);
+  const preSpeed = speed(preLatch);
+  const postSpeed = speed(postCut);
+  const headingDeltaDeg = angleBetweenDeg(preLatch, postCut);
+
+  assert(postSpeed >= preSpeed * 1.25,
+    `post-cut speed should be >=1.25x pre-latch speed; ${postSpeed.toFixed(2)} vs ${preSpeed.toFixed(2)}`);
+  assert(headingDeltaDeg >= 70,
+    `post-cut heading should change by >=70 degrees; got ${headingDeltaDeg.toFixed(1)}`);
+  assert.equal(events.released.length, 1, 'tetherCut should emit tether:released once');
+  assert.equal(events.released[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'released event should identify the asteroid');
+
+  const attachments = state.combat.attachments.byId;
+  const active = Object.values(attachments).filter((attachment) => attachment.state === 'active');
+  assert.equal(active.length, 0, 'tetherCut should leave no active attachment');
+}
+
+function createHarness() {
+  const state = createGameState(0x57d1);
+  state.mode = 'flight';
+  state.settings.gameplay.physicsBackend = 'rapier-dynamic';
+  state.settings.gameplay.flightBackend = 'v3';
+  state.settings.controls.flightMode = 'newtonian';
+  state.entities.clear();
+  state.entityList.length = 0;
+  state.nextEntityId = 1;
+  state.freeIds.length = 0;
+
+  const bus = createBus();
+  const helpers = {};
+  const runtime = {
+    core: fork(core),
+    physics: fork(physics),
+    actions: fork(actions),
+    flight: fork(flightV3),
+    combat: fork(combat),
+    tetherGameplay: fork(tetherGameplay),
+  };
+  const byName = new Map([
+    ['core', runtime.core],
+    ['physics', runtime.physics],
+    ['actions', runtime.actions],
+    ['flight', runtime.flight],
+    ['combat', runtime.combat],
+    ['tetherGameplay', runtime.tetherGameplay],
+  ]);
+  const registry = {
+    get(name) { return byName.get(name) || null; },
+  };
+  const ctx = { state, bus, helpers, registry };
+
+  const events = { latched: [], strain: [], broke: [], released: [] };
+  bus.on('tether:latched', (payload) => events.latched.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:strain', (payload) => events.strain.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:broke', (payload) => events.broke.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:released', (payload) => events.released.push(payload));
+
+  runtime.core.init(ctx);
+  return { state, bus, helpers, registry, runtime, ctx, events };
+}
+
+function initializeSystems(harness) {
+  const { runtime, ctx } = harness;
+  runtime.physics.init(ctx);
+  runtime.actions.init(ctx);
+  runtime.flight.init(ctx);
+  runtime.combat.init(ctx);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.init(ctx);
+}
+
+async function ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state) {
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  if (runtime.physics._sg02Init) await runtime.physics._sg02Init;
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  assert(runtime.physics._sg02, 'SG-02 dynamic body owner should initialize for tether gameplay check');
+}
+
+function stepHarness(harness) {
+  const { runtime, state } = harness;
+  runtime.core.preStep(DT, state);
+  runtime.actions.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.flight.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.physics.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.combat.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.core.lifetimeSweep(DT, state);
+}
+
+function readPhysicsMass(runtime, entityId) {
+  const rec = runtime.physics._sg02 && runtime.physics._sg02.records.get(entityId);
+  return rec && rec.spec && rec.spec.mass;
+}
+
+function assertNpmScript(name) {
+  const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', name], {
+    cwd: new URL('../', import.meta.url),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    shell: process.platform === 'win32',
+  });
+  if (result.status !== 0) {
+    process.stdout.write(result.stdout || '');
+    process.stderr.write(result.stderr || '');
+  }
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${name} should pass`);
+}
+
+function fork(definition) {
+  return Object.create(definition);
+}
+
+function velocityVector(entity) {
+  return { x: entity.vel.x, z: entity.vel.z };
+}
+
+function speed(vector) {
+  return Math.hypot(vector.x, vector.z);
+}
+
+function angleBetweenDeg(a, b) {
+  const al = speed(a);
+  const bl = speed(b);
+  if (!(al > 0) || !(bl > 0)) return 0;
+  const dot = (a.x * b.x + a.z * b.z) / (al * bl);
+  const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dot));
+  return Math.acos(clamped) * 180 / Math.PI;
+}

diff --git a/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4be3c6241f066121f8d20e4539e28a7b27caf8ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
@@ -0,0 +1,199 @@
+// Tether gameplay system (GDD 2.0 §4.3, BUILD_PLAN WS-D1).
+// Consumes the locked input action contract and wires the existing SG-03/SG-02 attachment
+// service into player flight. Rapier owns momentum exchange; this system only targets,
+// reels, cuts, and emits player-facing gameplay events.
+import { queryNearbyEntities } from '../core/spatialQuery.js';
+
+const TETHER_DEF_ID = 'tether_standard';
+const STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S = 0.2;
+const ATTACHABLE_TYPES = new Set(['asteroid', 'wreck', 'ship', 'drone', 'station', 'payload']);
+
+export const tetherGameplay = {
+  id: 'tetherGameplay',
+  name: 'tetherGameplay',
+
+  init(ctx) {
+    this.state = ctx.state;
+    this.bus = ctx.bus;
+    this.helpers = ctx.helpers;
+    this.registry = ctx.registry;
+    this._targetScratch = [];
+    this._active = null;
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  update(dt, state) {
+    if (state.mode !== 'flight') return;
+    const player = state.entities && state.entities.get ? state.entities.get(state.playerId) : null;
+    if (!player || !player.alive || (player.flags && player.flags.docked)) return;
+
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const attachments = kernel && kernel.attachments;
+    if (!attachments) return;
+
+    this._reconcileActive(attachments, state);
+    const actions = state.input?.actions;
+
+    if (this._active && actions?.tetherCut) {
+      const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+      const result = attachments.cut(this._active.attachmentId, player.id, 'tether_cut');
+      if (result && result.ok) this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+      this._active = null;
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (this._active) {
+      this._reelActive(attachments, actions?.reelDelta, dt);
+      this._emitStrain(attachments, state);
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!actions?.tetherFire) return;
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, TETHER_DEF_ID);
+    if (!def) return;
+    const target = this._acquireTarget(player, def, state);
+    if (!target) return;
+
+    const result = attachments.create({
+      defId: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+      ownerId: player.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+    });
+    if (!result || !result.ok || !result.attachment) return;
+
+    this._active = {
+      attachmentId: result.attachment.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+      type: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+    };
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:latched', { targetId: target.id, type: TETHER_DEF_ID });
+  },
+
+  _acquireTarget(player, def, state) {
+    const maxLength = positive(def && def.maxLength, positive(def && def.break && def.break.maxLength, 260));
+    const aim = aimWorldFor(player, state, maxLength);
+    const candidates = queryNearbyEntities(
+      state,
+      aim,
+      maxLength,
+      this._targetScratch,
+      state.entityList || [],
+    );
+
+    let best = null;
+    let bestAimD2 = Infinity;
+    let bestId = Infinity;
+    for (const entity of candidates) {
+      if (!isAttachable(entity, player.id)) continue;
+      const dxPlayer = entity.pos.x - player.pos.x;
+      const dzPlayer = entity.pos.z - player.pos.z;
+      const playerDistance = Math.hypot(dxPlayer, dzPlayer);
+      if (playerDistance > maxLength + (entity.radius || 0)) continue;
+
+      const dxAim = entity.pos.x - aim.x;
+      const dzAim = entity.pos.z - aim.z;
+      const aimD2 = dxAim * dxAim + dzAim * dzAim;
+      if (aimD2 > maxLength * maxLength) continue;
+      const id = sortableId(entity.id);
+      if (aimD2 < bestAimD2 || (aimD2 === bestAimD2 && id < bestId)) {
+        best = entity;
+        bestAimD2 = aimD2;
+        bestId = id;
+      }
+    }
+    return best;
+  },
+
+  _reconcileActive(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (attachment && attachment.state === 'active') return;
+    const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+    const reason = attachment && attachment.breakReason;
+    this._active = null;
+    if (reason === 'tether_cut') this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+    else this.bus.emit('tether:broke', { targetId });
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  _reelActive(attachments, reelDelta, dt) {
+    if (!this._active || !Number.isFinite(reelDelta) || reelDelta === 0) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    if (!def) return;
+
+    const maxStep = positive(def.reelRate, 0) * Math.max(0, Number(dt) || 0);
+    if (!(maxStep > 0)) return;
+    const requested = clamp(reelDelta, -maxStep, maxStep);
+    const minLength = positive(def.minLength, 0);
+    const maxLength = positive(def.maxLength, Infinity);
+    const next = clamp((attachment.restLength || 0) + requested, minLength, maxLength);
+    const delta = next - (attachment.restLength || 0);
+    if (Math.abs(delta) <= 1e-6) return;
+    attachments.reel(attachment.id, delta, minLength);
+  },
+
+  _emitStrain(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const now = Number.isFinite(state.simTime) ? state.simTime : state.tick / 60;
+    if (now - this._lastStrainT < STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    const threshold = positive(def && (def.breakTension || (def.break && def.break.maxTension)), 0);
+    if (!(threshold > 0)) return;
+    const ratio = Math.max(0, finite(attachment.lastTension) / threshold);
+    this._lastStrainT = now;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:strain', { ratio });
+  },
+};
+
+function combatKernel(host) {
+  const actions = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('actions');
+  if (actions && actions.kernel) return actions.kernel;
+  const combat = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('combat');
+  return combat && combat.kernel ? combat.kernel : null;
+}
+
+function attachmentDef(kernel, id) {
+  return kernel && kernel.catalog && kernel.catalog.attachments && kernel.catalog.attachments.get(id) || null;
+}
+
+function aimWorldFor(player, state, range) {
+  const aim = state.input?.aimWorld;
+  if (Number.isFinite(aim?.x) && Number.isFinite(aim?.z)) return { x: aim.x, z: aim.z };
+  const angle = Number.isFinite(state.input?.aimAngle) ? state.input.aimAngle : (player.rot || 0);
+  return {
+    x: player.pos.x + Math.cos(angle) * range,
+    z: player.pos.z + Math.sin(angle) * range,
+  };
+}
+
+function isAttachable(entity, playerId) {
+  if (!entity || !entity.alive || !entity.pos || entity.id === playerId) return false;
+  if (ATTACHABLE_TYPES.has(entity.type)) return true;
+  if (entity.type !== 'pickup') return false;
+  const data = entity.data || {};
+  if (data.kind !== 'cargo' && data.kind !== 'ore') return false;
+  return (Number(data.amount) || 0) > 5;
+}
+
+function sortableId(id) {
+  return Number.isFinite(id) ? id : String(id).charCodeAt(0);
+}
+
+function clamp(value, lo, hi) {
+  return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, value));
+}
+
+function positive(value, fallback) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
+}
+
+function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
+}

       if (!firing && state.input.autoFire) {
         autoTgt = this._autoFireTarget(player, state);
         firing = !!autoTgt;

diff --git a/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..095821825c23af2afa14dc5721b2b40de25a462f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+
+import { createBus } from '../src/core/eventBus.js';
+import { createGameState } from '../src/core/gameState.js';
+import { core } from '../src/core/coreSystem.js';
+import { physics } from '../src/core/physics.js';
+import { SIM_DT } from '../src/core/sim.js';
+import { actions } from '../src/systems/actions.js';
+import { combat } from '../src/systems/combat.js';
+import { flightV3 } from '../src/systems/flightV3.js';
+import { makeShipEntitySpec } from '../src/systems/ships.js';
+import { tetherGameplay } from '../src/systems/tetherGameplay.js';
+
+const DT = SIM_DT;
+const ARC_TICKS = Math.round(1.2 / DT);
+
+await assertGameplaySlingshot();
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether');
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether-break');
+
+console.log('Tether gameplay checks OK');
+
+async function assertGameplaySlingshot() {
+  const harness = createHarness();
+  const { state, helpers, runtime, events } = harness;
+
+  const player = helpers.spawnEntity(makeShipEntitySpec('ship_wasp', {
+    isPlayer: true,
+    pos: { x: -20, z: -92 },
+    rot: 0,
+  }));
+  state.playerId = player.id;
+  const asteroid = helpers.spawnEntity({
+    type: 'asteroid',
+    pos: { x: 0, z: 0 },
+    radius: 11,
+    mass: 640,
+    hull: 360,
+    hullMax: 360,
+    collides: true,
+    data: { typeId: 'ast_common_rock', oreHP: 360, oreHPMax: 360, yieldU: 12 },
+  });
+
+  player.vel.x = player.maxSpeed * 0.8;
+  player.vel.z = 0;
+  player.boost.energy = player.boost.max;
+  state.input.actions = { tetherFire: false, tetherCut: false, reelDelta: 0 };
+  state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+  state.input.aimAngle = 0;
+  state.input.moveX = 0;
+  state.input.moveZ = 1;
+  state.input.boost = true;
+
+  initializeSystems(harness);
+  await ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state);
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, player.id), player.mass, 'player Rapier mass should come from the ship def mass');
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, asteroid.id), asteroid.mass, 'asteroid Rapier mass should come from entity mass');
+
+  const preLatch = velocityVector(player);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = false;
+
+  assert.equal(events.latched.length, 1, 'tetherFire should emit tether:latched once');
+  assert.equal(events.latched[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'tether should latch the aimed asteroid');
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < ARC_TICKS; i++) {
+    state.input.actions.reelDelta = 0;
+    state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+    stepHarness(harness);
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(events.broke.length, 0, 'mid asteroid slingshot should not break the standard tether');
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = false;
+
+  const postCut = velocityVector(player);
+  const preSpeed = speed(preLatch);
+  const postSpeed = speed(postCut);
+  const headingDeltaDeg = angleBetweenDeg(preLatch, postCut);
+
+  assert(postSpeed >= preSpeed * 1.25,
+    `post-cut speed should be >=1.25x pre-latch speed; ${postSpeed.toFixed(2)} vs ${preSpeed.toFixed(2)}`);
+  assert(headingDeltaDeg >= 70,
+    `post-cut heading should change by >=70 degrees; got ${headingDeltaDeg.toFixed(1)}`);
+  assert.equal(events.released.length, 1, 'tetherCut should emit tether:released once');
+  assert.equal(events.released[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'released event should identify the asteroid');
+
+  const attachments = state.combat.attachments.byId;
+  const active = Object.values(attachments).filter((attachment) => attachment.state === 'active');
+  assert.equal(active.length, 0, 'tetherCut should leave no active attachment');
+}
+
+function createHarness() {
+  const state = createGameState(0x57d1);
+  state.mode = 'flight';
+  state.settings.gameplay.physicsBackend = 'rapier-dynamic';
+  state.settings.gameplay.flightBackend = 'v3';
+  state.settings.controls.flightMode = 'newtonian';
+  state.entities.clear();
+  state.entityList.length = 0;
+  state.nextEntityId = 1;
+  state.freeIds.length = 0;
+
+  const bus = createBus();
+  const helpers = {};
+  const runtime = {
+    core: fork(core),
+    physics: fork(physics),
+    actions: fork(actions),
+    flight: fork(flightV3),
+    combat: fork(combat),
+    tetherGameplay: fork(tetherGameplay),
+  };
+  const byName = new Map([
+    ['core', runtime.core],
+    ['physics', runtime.physics],
+    ['actions', runtime.actions],
+    ['flight', runtime.flight],
+    ['combat', runtime.combat],
+    ['tetherGameplay', runtime.tetherGameplay],
+  ]);
+  const registry = {
+    get(name) { return byName.get(name) || null; },
+  };
+  const ctx = { state, bus, helpers, registry };
+
+  const events = { latched: [], strain: [], broke: [], released: [] };
+  bus.on('tether:latched', (payload) => events.latched.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:strain', (payload) => events.strain.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:broke', (payload) => events.broke.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:released', (payload) => events.released.push(payload));
+
+  runtime.core.init(ctx);
+  return { state, bus, helpers, registry, runtime, ctx, events };
+}
+
+function initializeSystems(harness) {
+  const { runtime, ctx } = harness;
+  runtime.physics.init(ctx);
+  runtime.actions.init(ctx);
+  runtime.flight.init(ctx);
+  runtime.combat.init(ctx);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.init(ctx);
+}
+
+async function ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state) {
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  if (runtime.physics._sg02Init) await runtime.physics._sg02Init;
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  assert(runtime.physics._sg02, 'SG-02 dynamic body owner should initialize for tether gameplay check');
+}
+
+function stepHarness(harness) {
+  const { runtime, state } = harness;
+  runtime.core.preStep(DT, state);
+  runtime.actions.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.flight.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.physics.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.combat.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.core.lifetimeSweep(DT, state);
+}
+
+function readPhysicsMass(runtime, entityId) {
+  const rec = runtime.physics._sg02 && runtime.physics._sg02.records.get(entityId);
+  return rec && rec.spec && rec.spec.mass;
+}
+
+function assertNpmScript(name) {
+  const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', name], {
+    cwd: new URL('../', import.meta.url),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    shell: process.platform === 'win32',
+  });
+  if (result.status !== 0) {
+    process.stdout.write(result.stdout || '');
+    process.stderr.write(result.stderr || '');
+  }
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${name} should pass`);
+}
+
+function fork(definition) {
+  return Object.create(definition);
+}
+
+function velocityVector(entity) {
+  return { x: entity.vel.x, z: entity.vel.z };
+}
+
+function speed(vector) {
+  return Math.hypot(vector.x, vector.z);
+}
+
+function angleBetweenDeg(a, b) {
+  const al = speed(a);
+  const bl = speed(b);
+  if (!(al > 0) || !(bl > 0)) return 0;
+  const dot = (a.x * b.x + a.z * b.z) / (al * bl);
+  const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dot));
+  return Math.acos(clamped) * 180 / Math.PI;
+}

diff --git a/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4be3c6241f066121f8d20e4539e28a7b27caf8ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
@@ -0,0 +1,199 @@
+// Tether gameplay system (GDD 2.0 §4.3, BUILD_PLAN WS-D1).
+// Consumes the locked input action contract and wires the existing SG-03/SG-02 attachment
+// service into player flight. Rapier owns momentum exchange; this system only targets,
+// reels, cuts, and emits player-facing gameplay events.
+import { queryNearbyEntities } from '../core/spatialQuery.js';
+
+const TETHER_DEF_ID = 'tether_standard';
+const STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S = 0.2;
+const ATTACHABLE_TYPES = new Set(['asteroid', 'wreck', 'ship', 'drone', 'station', 'payload']);
+
+export const tetherGameplay = {
+  id: 'tetherGameplay',
+  name: 'tetherGameplay',
+
+  init(ctx) {
+    this.state = ctx.state;
+    this.bus = ctx.bus;
+    this.helpers = ctx.helpers;
+    this.registry = ctx.registry;
+    this._targetScratch = [];
+    this._active = null;
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  update(dt, state) {
+    if (state.mode !== 'flight') return;
+    const player = state.entities && state.entities.get ? state.entities.get(state.playerId) : null;
+    if (!player || !player.alive || (player.flags && player.flags.docked)) return;
+
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const attachments = kernel && kernel.attachments;
+    if (!attachments) return;
+
+    this._reconcileActive(attachments, state);
+    const actions = state.input?.actions;
+
+    if (this._active && actions?.tetherCut) {
+      const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+      const result = attachments.cut(this._active.attachmentId, player.id, 'tether_cut');
+      if (result && result.ok) this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+      this._active = null;
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (this._active) {
+      this._reelActive(attachments, actions?.reelDelta, dt);
+      this._emitStrain(attachments, state);
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!actions?.tetherFire) return;
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, TETHER_DEF_ID);
+    if (!def) return;
+    const target = this._acquireTarget(player, def, state);
+    if (!target) return;
+
+    const result = attachments.create({
+      defId: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+      ownerId: player.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+    });
+    if (!result || !result.ok || !result.attachment) return;
+
+    this._active = {
+      attachmentId: result.attachment.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+      type: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+    };
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:latched', { targetId: target.id, type: TETHER_DEF_ID });
+  },
+
+  _acquireTarget(player, def, state) {
+    const maxLength = positive(def && def.maxLength, positive(def && def.break && def.break.maxLength, 260));
+    const aim = aimWorldFor(player, state, maxLength);
+    const candidates = queryNearbyEntities(
+      state,
+      aim,
+      maxLength,
+      this._targetScratch,
+      state.entityList || [],
+    );
+
+    let best = null;
+    let bestAimD2 = Infinity;
+    let bestId = Infinity;
+    for (const entity of candidates) {
+      if (!isAttachable(entity, player.id)) continue;
+      const dxPlayer = entity.pos.x - player.pos.x;
+      const dzPlayer = entity.pos.z - player.pos.z;
+      const playerDistance = Math.hypot(dxPlayer, dzPlayer);
+      if (playerDistance > maxLength + (entity.radius || 0)) continue;
+
+      const dxAim = entity.pos.x - aim.x;
+      const dzAim = entity.pos.z - aim.z;
+      const aimD2 = dxAim * dxAim + dzAim * dzAim;
+      if (aimD2 > maxLength * maxLength) continue;
+      const id = sortableId(entity.id);
+      if (aimD2 < bestAimD2 || (aimD2 === bestAimD2 && id < bestId)) {
+        best = entity;
+        bestAimD2 = aimD2;
+        bestId = id;
+      }
+    }
+    return best;
+  },
+
+  _reconcileActive(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (attachment && attachment.state === 'active') return;
+    const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+    const reason = attachment && attachment.breakReason;
+    this._active = null;
+    if (reason === 'tether_cut') this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+    else this.bus.emit('tether:broke', { targetId });
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  _reelActive(attachments, reelDelta, dt) {
+    if (!this._active || !Number.isFinite(reelDelta) || reelDelta === 0) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    if (!def) return;
+
+    const maxStep = positive(def.reelRate, 0) * Math.max(0, Number(dt) || 0);
+    if (!(maxStep > 0)) return;
+    const requested = clamp(reelDelta, -maxStep, maxStep);
+    const minLength = positive(def.minLength, 0);
+    const maxLength = positive(def.maxLength, Infinity);
+    const next = clamp((attachment.restLength || 0) + requested, minLength, maxLength);
+    const delta = next - (attachment.restLength || 0);
+    if (Math.abs(delta) <= 1e-6) return;
+    attachments.reel(attachment.id, delta, minLength);
+  },
+
+  _emitStrain(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const now = Number.isFinite(state.simTime) ? state.simTime : state.tick / 60;
+    if (now - this._lastStrainT < STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    const threshold = positive(def && (def.breakTension || (def.break && def.break.maxTension)), 0);
+    if (!(threshold > 0)) return;
+    const ratio = Math.max(0, finite(attachment.lastTension) / threshold);
+    this._lastStrainT = now;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:strain', { ratio });
+  },
+};
+
+function combatKernel(host) {
+  const actions = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('actions');
+  if (actions && actions.kernel) return actions.kernel;
+  const combat = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('combat');
+  return combat && combat.kernel ? combat.kernel : null;
+}
+
+function attachmentDef(kernel, id) {
+  return kernel && kernel.catalog && kernel.catalog.attachments && kernel.catalog.attachments.get(id) || null;
+}
+
+function aimWorldFor(player, state, range) {
+  const aim = state.input?.aimWorld;
+  if (Number.isFinite(aim?.x) && Number.isFinite(aim?.z)) return { x: aim.x, z: aim.z };
+  const angle = Number.isFinite(state.input?.aimAngle) ? state.input.aimAngle : (player.rot || 0);
+  return {
+    x: player.pos.x + Math.cos(angle) * range,
+    z: player.pos.z + Math.sin(angle) * range,
+  };
+}
+
+function isAttachable(entity, playerId) {
+  if (!entity || !entity.alive || !entity.pos || entity.id === playerId) return false;
+  if (ATTACHABLE_TYPES.has(entity.type)) return true;
+  if (entity.type !== 'pickup') return false;
+  const data = entity.data || {};
+  if (data.kind !== 'cargo' && data.kind !== 'ore') return false;
+  return (Number(data.amount) || 0) > 5;
+}
+
+function sortableId(id) {
+  return Number.isFinite(id) ? id : String(id).charCodeAt(0);
+}
+
+function clamp(value, lo, hi) {
+  return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, value));
+}
+
+function positive(value, fallback) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
+}
+
+function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
+}

diff --git a/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..095821825c23af2afa14dc5721b2b40de25a462f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/check-tether-gameplay.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+
+import { createBus } from '../src/core/eventBus.js';
+import { createGameState } from '../src/core/gameState.js';
+import { core } from '../src/core/coreSystem.js';
+import { physics } from '../src/core/physics.js';
+import { SIM_DT } from '../src/core/sim.js';
+import { actions } from '../src/systems/actions.js';
+import { combat } from '../src/systems/combat.js';
+import { flightV3 } from '../src/systems/flightV3.js';
+import { makeShipEntitySpec } from '../src/systems/ships.js';
+import { tetherGameplay } from '../src/systems/tetherGameplay.js';
+
+const DT = SIM_DT;
+const ARC_TICKS = Math.round(1.2 / DT);
+
+await assertGameplaySlingshot();
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether');
+assertNpmScript('check:sg02:tether-break');
+
+console.log('Tether gameplay checks OK');
+
+async function assertGameplaySlingshot() {
+  const harness = createHarness();
+  const { state, helpers, runtime, events } = harness;
+
+  const player = helpers.spawnEntity(makeShipEntitySpec('ship_wasp', {
+    isPlayer: true,
+    pos: { x: -20, z: -92 },
+    rot: 0,
+  }));
+  state.playerId = player.id;
+  const asteroid = helpers.spawnEntity({
+    type: 'asteroid',
+    pos: { x: 0, z: 0 },
+    radius: 11,
+    mass: 640,
+    hull: 360,
+    hullMax: 360,
+    collides: true,
+    data: { typeId: 'ast_common_rock', oreHP: 360, oreHPMax: 360, yieldU: 12 },
+  });
+
+  player.vel.x = player.maxSpeed * 0.8;
+  player.vel.z = 0;
+  player.boost.energy = player.boost.max;
+  state.input.actions = { tetherFire: false, tetherCut: false, reelDelta: 0 };
+  state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+  state.input.aimAngle = 0;
+  state.input.moveX = 0;
+  state.input.moveZ = 1;
+  state.input.boost = true;
+
+  initializeSystems(harness);
+  await ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state);
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, player.id), player.mass, 'player Rapier mass should come from the ship def mass');
+  assert.equal(readPhysicsMass(runtime, asteroid.id), asteroid.mass, 'asteroid Rapier mass should come from entity mass');
+
+  const preLatch = velocityVector(player);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherFire = false;
+
+  assert.equal(events.latched.length, 1, 'tetherFire should emit tether:latched once');
+  assert.equal(events.latched[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'tether should latch the aimed asteroid');
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < ARC_TICKS; i++) {
+    state.input.actions.reelDelta = 0;
+    state.input.aimWorld = { x: asteroid.pos.x, z: asteroid.pos.z };
+    stepHarness(harness);
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(events.broke.length, 0, 'mid asteroid slingshot should not break the standard tether');
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = true;
+  stepHarness(harness);
+  state.input.actions.tetherCut = false;
+
+  const postCut = velocityVector(player);
+  const preSpeed = speed(preLatch);
+  const postSpeed = speed(postCut);
+  const headingDeltaDeg = angleBetweenDeg(preLatch, postCut);
+
+  assert(postSpeed >= preSpeed * 1.25,
+    `post-cut speed should be >=1.25x pre-latch speed; ${postSpeed.toFixed(2)} vs ${preSpeed.toFixed(2)}`);
+  assert(headingDeltaDeg >= 70,
+    `post-cut heading should change by >=70 degrees; got ${headingDeltaDeg.toFixed(1)}`);
+  assert.equal(events.released.length, 1, 'tetherCut should emit tether:released once');
+  assert.equal(events.released[0].targetId, asteroid.id, 'released event should identify the asteroid');
+
+  const attachments = state.combat.attachments.byId;
+  const active = Object.values(attachments).filter((attachment) => attachment.state === 'active');
+  assert.equal(active.length, 0, 'tetherCut should leave no active attachment');
+}
+
+function createHarness() {
+  const state = createGameState(0x57d1);
+  state.mode = 'flight';
+  state.settings.gameplay.physicsBackend = 'rapier-dynamic';
+  state.settings.gameplay.flightBackend = 'v3';
+  state.settings.controls.flightMode = 'newtonian';
+  state.entities.clear();
+  state.entityList.length = 0;
+  state.nextEntityId = 1;
+  state.freeIds.length = 0;
+
+  const bus = createBus();
+  const helpers = {};
+  const runtime = {
+    core: fork(core),
+    physics: fork(physics),
+    actions: fork(actions),
+    flight: fork(flightV3),
+    combat: fork(combat),
+    tetherGameplay: fork(tetherGameplay),
+  };
+  const byName = new Map([
+    ['core', runtime.core],
+    ['physics', runtime.physics],
+    ['actions', runtime.actions],
+    ['flight', runtime.flight],
+    ['combat', runtime.combat],
+    ['tetherGameplay', runtime.tetherGameplay],
+  ]);
+  const registry = {
+    get(name) { return byName.get(name) || null; },
+  };
+  const ctx = { state, bus, helpers, registry };
+
+  const events = { latched: [], strain: [], broke: [], released: [] };
+  bus.on('tether:latched', (payload) => events.latched.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:strain', (payload) => events.strain.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:broke', (payload) => events.broke.push(payload));
+  bus.on('tether:released', (payload) => events.released.push(payload));
+
+  runtime.core.init(ctx);
+  return { state, bus, helpers, registry, runtime, ctx, events };
+}
+
+function initializeSystems(harness) {
+  const { runtime, ctx } = harness;
+  runtime.physics.init(ctx);
+  runtime.actions.init(ctx);
+  runtime.flight.init(ctx);
+  runtime.combat.init(ctx);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.init(ctx);
+}
+
+async function ensureSg02Ready(runtime, state) {
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  if (runtime.physics._sg02Init) await runtime.physics._sg02Init;
+  runtime.physics.update(0, state);
+  assert(runtime.physics._sg02, 'SG-02 dynamic body owner should initialize for tether gameplay check');
+}
+
+function stepHarness(harness) {
+  const { runtime, state } = harness;
+  runtime.core.preStep(DT, state);
+  runtime.actions.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.flight.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.physics.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.combat.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.tetherGameplay.update(DT, state);
+  runtime.core.lifetimeSweep(DT, state);
+}
+
+function readPhysicsMass(runtime, entityId) {
+  const rec = runtime.physics._sg02 && runtime.physics._sg02.records.get(entityId);
+  return rec && rec.spec && rec.spec.mass;
+}
+
+function assertNpmScript(name) {
+  const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', name], {
+    cwd: new URL('../', import.meta.url),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    shell: process.platform === 'win32',
+  });
+  if (result.status !== 0) {
+    process.stdout.write(result.stdout || '');
+    process.stderr.write(result.stderr || '');
+  }
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${name} should pass`);
+}
+
+function fork(definition) {
+  return Object.create(definition);
+}
+
+function velocityVector(entity) {
+  return { x: entity.vel.x, z: entity.vel.z };
+}
+
+function speed(vector) {
+  return Math.hypot(vector.x, vector.z);
+}
+
+function angleBetweenDeg(a, b) {
+  const al = speed(a);
+  const bl = speed(b);
+  if (!(al > 0) || !(bl > 0)) return 0;
+  const dot = (a.x * b.x + a.z * b.z) / (al * bl);
+  const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dot));
+  return Math.acos(clamped) * 180 / Math.PI;
+}

diff --git a/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4be3c6241f066121f8d20e4539e28a7b27caf8ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/systems/tetherGameplay.js
@@ -0,0 +1,199 @@
+// Tether gameplay system (GDD 2.0 §4.3, BUILD_PLAN WS-D1).
+// Consumes the locked input action contract and wires the existing SG-03/SG-02 attachment
+// service into player flight. Rapier owns momentum exchange; this system only targets,
+// reels, cuts, and emits player-facing gameplay events.
+import { queryNearbyEntities } from '../core/spatialQuery.js';
+
+const TETHER_DEF_ID = 'tether_standard';
+const STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S = 0.2;
+const ATTACHABLE_TYPES = new Set(['asteroid', 'wreck', 'ship', 'drone', 'station', 'payload']);
+
+export const tetherGameplay = {
+  id: 'tetherGameplay',
+  name: 'tetherGameplay',
+
+  init(ctx) {
+    this.state = ctx.state;
+    this.bus = ctx.bus;
+    this.helpers = ctx.helpers;
+    this.registry = ctx.registry;
+    this._targetScratch = [];
+    this._active = null;
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  update(dt, state) {
+    if (state.mode !== 'flight') return;
+    const player = state.entities && state.entities.get ? state.entities.get(state.playerId) : null;
+    if (!player || !player.alive || (player.flags && player.flags.docked)) return;
+
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const attachments = kernel && kernel.attachments;
+    if (!attachments) return;
+
+    this._reconcileActive(attachments, state);
+    const actions = state.input?.actions;
+
+    if (this._active && actions?.tetherCut) {
+      const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+      const result = attachments.cut(this._active.attachmentId, player.id, 'tether_cut');
+      if (result && result.ok) this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+      this._active = null;
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (this._active) {
+      this._reelActive(attachments, actions?.reelDelta, dt);
+      this._emitStrain(attachments, state);
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!actions?.tetherFire) return;
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, TETHER_DEF_ID);
+    if (!def) return;
+    const target = this._acquireTarget(player, def, state);
+    if (!target) return;
+
+    const result = attachments.create({
+      defId: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+      ownerId: player.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+    });
+    if (!result || !result.ok || !result.attachment) return;
+
+    this._active = {
+      attachmentId: result.attachment.id,
+      targetId: target.id,
+      type: TETHER_DEF_ID,
+    };
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:latched', { targetId: target.id, type: TETHER_DEF_ID });
+  },
+
+  _acquireTarget(player, def, state) {
+    const maxLength = positive(def && def.maxLength, positive(def && def.break && def.break.maxLength, 260));
+    const aim = aimWorldFor(player, state, maxLength);
+    const candidates = queryNearbyEntities(
+      state,
+      aim,
+      maxLength,
+      this._targetScratch,
+      state.entityList || [],
+    );
+
+    let best = null;
+    let bestAimD2 = Infinity;
+    let bestId = Infinity;
+    for (const entity of candidates) {
+      if (!isAttachable(entity, player.id)) continue;
+      const dxPlayer = entity.pos.x - player.pos.x;
+      const dzPlayer = entity.pos.z - player.pos.z;
+      const playerDistance = Math.hypot(dxPlayer, dzPlayer);
+      if (playerDistance > maxLength + (entity.radius || 0)) continue;
+
+      const dxAim = entity.pos.x - aim.x;
+      const dzAim = entity.pos.z - aim.z;
+      const aimD2 = dxAim * dxAim + dzAim * dzAim;
+      if (aimD2 > maxLength * maxLength) continue;
+      const id = sortableId(entity.id);
+      if (aimD2 < bestAimD2 || (aimD2 === bestAimD2 && id < bestId)) {
+        best = entity;
+        bestAimD2 = aimD2;
+        bestId = id;
+      }
+    }
+    return best;
+  },
+
+  _reconcileActive(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (attachment && attachment.state === 'active') return;
+    const targetId = this._active.targetId;
+    const reason = attachment && attachment.breakReason;
+    this._active = null;
+    if (reason === 'tether_cut') this.bus.emit('tether:released', { targetId });
+    else this.bus.emit('tether:broke', { targetId });
+    this._lastStrainT = -Infinity;
+  },
+
+  _reelActive(attachments, reelDelta, dt) {
+    if (!this._active || !Number.isFinite(reelDelta) || reelDelta === 0) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    if (!def) return;
+
+    const maxStep = positive(def.reelRate, 0) * Math.max(0, Number(dt) || 0);
+    if (!(maxStep > 0)) return;
+    const requested = clamp(reelDelta, -maxStep, maxStep);
+    const minLength = positive(def.minLength, 0);
+    const maxLength = positive(def.maxLength, Infinity);
+    const next = clamp((attachment.restLength || 0) + requested, minLength, maxLength);
+    const delta = next - (attachment.restLength || 0);
+    if (Math.abs(delta) <= 1e-6) return;
+    attachments.reel(attachment.id, delta, minLength);
+  },
+
+  _emitStrain(attachments, state) {
+    if (!this._active) return;
+    const now = Number.isFinite(state.simTime) ? state.simTime : state.tick / 60;
+    if (now - this._lastStrainT < STRAIN_EVENT_INTERVAL_S) return;
+    const attachment = attachments.get(this._active.attachmentId);
+    if (!attachment || attachment.state !== 'active') return;
+    const kernel = combatKernel(this);
+    const def = attachmentDef(kernel, attachment.defId);
+    const threshold = positive(def && (def.breakTension || (def.break && def.break.maxTension)), 0);
+    if (!(threshold > 0)) return;
+    const ratio = Math.max(0, finite(attachment.lastTension) / threshold);
+    this._lastStrainT = now;
+    this.bus.emit('tether:strain', { ratio });
+  },
+};
+
+function combatKernel(host) {
+  const actions = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('actions');
+  if (actions && actions.kernel) return actions.kernel;
+  const combat = host.registry && host.registry.get && host.registry.get('combat');
+  return combat && combat.kernel ? combat.kernel : null;
+}
+
+function attachmentDef(kernel, id) {
+  return kernel && kernel.catalog && kernel.catalog.attachments && kernel.catalog.attachments.get(id) || null;
+}
+
+function aimWorldFor(player, state, range) {
+  const aim = state.input?.aimWorld;
+  if (Number.isFinite(aim?.x) && Number.isFinite(aim?.z)) return { x: aim.x, z: aim.z };
+  const angle = Number.isFinite(state.input?.aimAngle) ? state.input.aimAngle : (player.rot || 0);
+  return {
+    x: player.pos.x + Math.cos(angle) * range,
+    z: player.pos.z + Math.sin(angle) * range,
+  };
+}
+
+function isAttachable(entity, playerId) {
+  if (!entity || !entity.alive || !entity.pos || entity.id === playerId) return false;
+  if (ATTACHABLE_TYPES.has(entity.type)) return true;
+  if (entity.type !== 'pickup') return false;
+  const data = entity.data || {};
+  if (data.kind !== 'cargo' && data.kind !== 'ore') return false;
+  return (Number(data.amount) || 0) > 5;
+}
+
+function sortableId(id) {
+  return Number.isFinite(id) ? id : String(id).charCodeAt(0);
+}
+
+function clamp(value, lo, hi) {
+  return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, value));
+}
+
+function positive(value, fallback) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
+}
+
+function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
+  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
+}
